Die Vergrößerung steigt kontinuierlich, doch die Kanten bleiben glatt; das Zoomzentrum bleibt auf demselben Detail. Das kleine Vergrößerungslabel bleibt oben links und zoomt nicht mit. original.reviewFocus: Push from the full poster into a planet, then a curve on its yellow outline. Keep increasing magnification while edges remain smooth, anchoring the zoom on the same detail. Keep the small magnification label at upper left rather than scaling it with the illustration. Hard-cut back to negative space after zooming, assemble central fragments into the brand symbol and unfold the wordmark. Choose a vector subject that supports several levels of detail when replacing the illustration.
